title: Kissed Filipino Beef Dinuguan
description: A cultured, monsoon‑inspired Filipino beef dinuguan that balances rich beef stock, tangy vinegar, and silky blood for a comforting braise.
instructions: Heat a large pot over medium heat and add a splash of oil.
Sauté minced garlic and sliced onion until fragrant and translucent.
Add the beef cubes and sear until browned on all sides.
Pour in vinegar, water, and soy sauce, stirring to combine.
Add bay leaves and peppercorns, then bring the mixture to a gentle boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 60 minutes until the beef is tender.
Slowly pour in the beef blood in a thin stream while stirring constantly to prevent curdling.
Season with salt and sugar, stirring until fully incorporated.
Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes to thicken the sauce.
Remove bay leaves, taste, and adjust seasoning if needed before serving hot over steamed rice.
